canonicalization.rule: Treat the CIET Barkhaa page and its item/language links as one provider collection with member-level manifestations; do not count each HTML link, mirror, download or language selector as an independent source identity.
canonicalization.language_boundary: Mundari and Mundari-Mix labels remain separate until the actual audio and provider metadata establish composition.
canonicalization.independence_warning: Educational adaptations/translations of the same Barkhaa story are not independent corroboration of cultural or linguistic claims merely because they exist in multiple languages.

promotion.reason: The official provider page establishes a concrete Mundari audio collection and item-level external locators, but not reusable-consent evidence, member-level redistribution terms, immutable hashes, speaker/dialect metadata, transcript concordance or cultural-access clearance.
